_comment: Display-only folder organization for the editor's Browse tab, curated by Atomic. Each folder groups mod CARDS under a heading; folders show in `order` (ascending), mods within a folder show in array order. This is purely presentation: it adds NO directories to any repo, and each mod stays a single card (all of a mod's versions already live under its own mods/<id>/ folder). A folder may hold mods drawn from any verified repo, referenced by repo + modId. A mod with no placement here falls into a default 'Uncategorized' group. EXCLUSIVE to this official repo: the editor reads folders.json only from here, so no other repo can define the Browse tab's folders.
